experiment: ECL Alpaca IEX three-class model comparison v1
features_source: Existing frozen B 24-feature schema, exact order; no new features
splits: Existing Alpaca rebuild train.csv and validation.csv; four fixed expanding date folds from binary research v3; no test input
fold_purge: Keep training decisions through each fold train_end only when future_datetime is earlier than the first validation decision timestamp

ridge_regression_to_3class.preprocessing: median imputer and StandardScaler fit inside each fold

xgboost_multiclass.class_weights: balanced sample weights computed from that fold's training labels

catboost_multiclass.status: not run; CatBoost was not installed; no package installation

hist_gradient_boosting_multiclass.class_weights: balanced sample weights computed from that fold's training labels

ridge_neutral_threshold_selection.primary: Select one symmetric predicted-return boundary from pooled chronological OOF predictions only; maximize three-class macro-F1 subject to predicted directional coverage >= max(40%, OOF actual directional prevalence - 10 percentage points), predicted neutral share <= OOF actual neutral share + 5 percentage points, and each predicted class >= 5% of OOF rows.
ridge_neutral_threshold_selection.if_no_threshold_is_feasible: Record the highest unconstrained macro-F1 grid point as a diagnostic only; mark Ridge threshold selection as guardrail-failed and exclude Ridge from candidate eligibility.
ridge_neutral_threshold_selection.diagnostic_zero_boundary: Sign only: positive=UP, nonpositive=DOWN; binary diagnostic, not a three-class neutral boundary

candidate_selection: Training OOF only: among candidates passing the same class-distribution guardrails, highest mean fold macro-F1; ties by mean balanced accuracy then mean directional macro-F1. If none pass, select the highest macro-F1 candidate for limited validation diagnosis and mark guardrail failure.
validation: After OOF selection and config freeze, fit the selected candidate on train.csv only and evaluate it once on validation.csv. Existing baseline validation predictions are read-only reference outputs; no model is refit on validation.
